guide.storagenexus.page.1:
Storage Nexus

Drawers, barrels, a simple storage network, remote tablets, dimensional links, conduits, all-in-one tools and the Essentials.

This book covers every block and item. Each item's tooltip also says what it does.
guide.storagenexus.page.10:
Fluids
A Fluid Drawer holds 32 buckets of one fluid. Use a bucket on it to fill or empty.

Fluid Intake: pulls a source block a second. Infinite water is never drained.

Infinite Lava Source: next to an intake, endless lava.
guide.storagenexus.page.11:
Fluid Intake
Takes fluid from the sources touching it and passes it to a Fluid Drawer, conduit or network next to it.

Bucket on it: take only that fluid. Sneak + empty hand: take anything again.
Empty hand: shows what it holds.
guide.storagenexus.page.12:
Storage network
Storage Connector: reads every inventory it touches.
Filtered Connector: only the one it faces.

Inventory Cable links connectors, Crafting Terminals, Fluid Intakes and Dimensional Outputs. No power needed.
guide.storagenexus.page.13:
Crafting Terminal
Shows everything in the network, fluids first. Search with @ to search by mod.
Left-click: take a stack.
Right-click: take one.
Shift-click: to your inventory.
Holding items: left puts in all, right puts in one.
guide.storagenexus.page.14:
Terminal extras
Bucket on a fluid: fill it. Full bucket: left pours, right stores.

Recipe book: click a recipe to fill the grid.

Red X by the grid: clears it into the network, else your inventory, else the floor.
guide.storagenexus.page.15:
Priority & filters
Right-click a connector to set its priority. Items go into higher priority first, and come out of lower priority first.

A filter in a Filtered Connector limits which items it accepts.
guide.storagenexus.page.16:
Import/Export Bus
Place it on an inventory or tank, next to a cable.
Import: pulls items and fluids into the network.
Export: pushes them out.

Right-click: mode and an optional filter. 32 items or a bucket every half second.
guide.storagenexus.page.17:
Level Emitter
Connect it to the network. Right-click it: click the slot with an item, set an amount, and choose at least or fewer than.

A bucket counts that fluid (in buckets) as well as bucket items. It gives a redstone signal while the condition is true.
guide.storagenexus.page.18:
Tablets
Sneak + right-click a Crafting Terminal with a Crafting Storage Tablet to link it.

Right-click the tablet anywhere, in any dimension, to open that network while the terminal is loaded.
guide.storagenexus.page.19:
Dimensional Anchor
Keeps the 3x3 chunks around it loaded.

Right-click to switch:
Always: always loaded.
On-demand: loaded only while a tablet is using a terminal there.
guide.storagenexus.page.2:
Drawers
1x1: 54 stacks
1x2: 27 per slot
2x2: 13.5 per slot

Right-click the front: insert what you hold.
Double-click: insert all matching.
Left-click: take a stack. Sneak: one.
Bar under each count: how full (red near full).
guide.storagenexus.page.20:
Dimensional links
Click a Dimensional Input with a Link Card, then click any Outputs.

Items and fluids put in the Input arrive at the Outputs, any distance or dimension. Outputs push into inventories, fluid storage, networks and item conduits on the sides you turn on.
guide.storagenexus.page.21:
Links, continued
Name a link by renaming the card in an anvil first.

Move an Input: break it, then click the new one with the same card.

Outputs can hold a filter. Transfer Speed Upgrade (Input): 1 = 16 items, 2 = stacks.
guide.storagenexus.page.22:
Conduits
Item and Fluid conduits come in Tier 1 and Tier 2. Tier 2 shows a green trim. Use a Tier 2 conduit on a Tier 1 to upgrade it.

Wrench: right-click a side to cycle its mode. Sneak + right-click: all its settings.
guide.storagenexus.page.23:
Conduit settings
Each side has an In and an Out colour: what a side extracts goes to sides that insert on the same colour. Arm rings: inner = In, outer = Out.
Also: redstone, priority, round-robin, filter, speed.
Full block on it: facade.
guide.storagenexus.page.24:
Filters
Right-click a filter to edit it: click items into its 9 slots, then choose allow or block, and whether to match exactly.

Advanced Filter: matches by item tag.
Fluids: use their bucket.
guide.storagenexus.page.25:
Reach and limits
Controller: 12 blocks; each slave 12 more.
Dimensional Anchor: 3x3 chunks.
Tablets and links: any distance or dimension.
Fluid Intake: the blocks touching it.
guide.storagenexus.page.26:
Limits, continued
One conduit line: up to 1024 conduits.
One storage network: up to 2048 cables, connectors and terminals.
Link names show for 3 seconds when you look at an Input or Output.
guide.storagenexus.page.27:
All-in-one tools
Pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword in one: copper to netherite, and Nexium.

Craft one from all five tools of a material, in any order. It holds every use they had left (5x one tool).
guide.storagenexus.page.28:
Using an AIOT
Mines what its material's tools mine, as fast.

Right-click: strip, scrape or make a path.
Sneak + right-click: till.

Hits like its axe at sword speed. Sweeps and disables shields.
guide.storagenexus.page.29:
AIOT enchantments
Every enchantment on the five tools carries over, at its highest level.

Silk Touch and Fortune both stay: switch them in the tool menu.
Sharpness, Smite, Bane: the highest stays.
Curses stay too.
guide.storagenexus.page.3:
Upgrades
Right-click a drawer with an upgrade to install it. Slots taken: a higher capacity upgrade swaps out the weakest.

See them: right-click a side or top empty-handed. Shows total capacity.
Left slot: Lock only.
guide.storagenexus.page.30:
Netherite AIOT
Smithing table: a diamond AIOT, a netherite upgrade template and a netherite block. Its enchantments and wear stay.

Or craft one from five netherite tools.
guide.storagenexus.page.31:
Tool menu
Hold an AIOT or a Nexium tool and press G.

Mining: switch Silk Touch and Fortune. The gem shows which: blue Silk Touch, green Fortune.
Haste II: on or off (Nexium).
Modules: next page.
guide.storagenexus.page.32:
AIOT modules
Put a module in a slot in the tool menu; the button beside it turns it on or off.

Nexus Link: what you mine goes into a storage network. Sneak + right-click a Crafting Terminal with it to link.
guide.storagenexus.page.33:
3x3 and vein mining
3x3: mines the 3x3 around each block, facing you.

Vein: hold the Vein Mine key and an ore or log takes every touching block of its kind. The tool menu sets how many.

Sneak: one block only.
guide.storagenexus.page.34:
Nexium
Crafting table: a block each of diamond, emerald and netherite and a netherite upgrade template make 3 Nexium ingots.

Smithing table: template, netherite gear and a Nexium ingot make Nexium gear.
guide.storagenexus.page.35:
Nexium gear
Sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, spear and armor. The mining tools give Haste II while held.

Armor: 4/9/7/4 points, 5 toughness each.

Nexium AIOT: five Nexium tools, or a netherite AIOT and a Nexium block.
guide.storagenexus.page.36:
Armor bonuses
Full Nexium set: Fire Resistance, full speed mining underwater and in the air, no knockback, Nexus restock (next page).
Helmet: Night Vision.

G with no tool in hand: switch each on or off.
guide.storagenexus.page.37:
Nexus restock
Sneak + right-click a Crafting Terminal with the chestplate to link it.

Hotbar stacks you use top up from the network at 8 left, and you eat from it when hungry (plain food only).
guide.storagenexus.page.38:
Essentials
Creepers and ghasts break no blocks and start no fires, but still hurt you. Item frames, armor stands and dropped items survive too.

Endermen never pick up blocks.

TNT and beds work as usual.
guide.storagenexus.page.39:
Trinket & wings
Two slots above your offhand slot: the trinket slot (top) takes the Magnet, the wings slot an elytra.

An elytra there glides while you wear a chestplate. Right-click or shift-click to put them on.
guide.storagenexus.page.4:
Upgrade types
Capacity: Iron x2, Gold x4, Diamond x8, Emerald x16, Netherite x32. Several add together.
Lock: goes in the lock slot. Empty slots stay reserved; a padlock shows on the front.
Void: deletes what doesn't fit, with a marker on the front's top-left.
guide.storagenexus.page.40:
Magnet
Works in your trinket slot: pulls items and XP to you, even through walls, and what you drop comes back.

Sneak + right-click it: range 4, 8, 12 or 16 blocks.
M: on or off. Turn it off to throw things away.
guide.storagenexus.page.41:
Elytra & piglins
An anvil puts all four protection enchantments on one elytra.

Any netherite armor counts as gold: piglins stay calm.

Ancient debris drops netherite scrap, more with Fortune. Silk Touch: the block.
guide.storagenexus.page.42:
Bedrock Breaking
Drink the Elixir of Bedrock Breaking: for 5 minutes, a diamond or netherite pickaxe mines bedrock like obsidian.

It drops nothing, and the bottom layer breaks too, so mind the void.
guide.storagenexus.page.43:
Picking up mobs
Sneak + right-click a mob with an empty hand: it becomes an item that keeps its health, name, gear and trades.

Right-click a block to let it out.
Not the Dragon or Wither. Pets: only their owner.
guide.storagenexus.page.44:
Iron Farm
Rename a chest Nexus Iron Farm in an anvil and put another chest next to it.

Fill the double chest with what a real farm takes (next page). Close it early to see what's missing.
guide.storagenexus.page.45:
Iron Farm recipe
4 zombies, 12 villagers (spawn eggs or picked-up mobs)
33 torches, 20 slabs
16 signs, 12 trapdoors
12 beds
Every other slot: a full stack of smooth stone.
guide.storagenexus.page.46:
Running the farm
About 1,900 iron an hour. Hoppers under it take the output. Redstone pauses it.

Bread: 10x faster, a loaf every 30 s. Then the bread slot locks for 10x as long as the boost lasted.
guide.storagenexus.page.5:
Compacting Drawer
Stores nuggets, ingots and blocks (any 9:1 or 4:1 recipe that works both ways) as one pool.

Top slot: largest form. Bottom: smaller forms.

Holds 54 stacks of the largest form, e.g. 54 stacks of iron blocks.
guide.storagenexus.page.6:
Moving storage
Breaking a drawer, compacting drawer or fluid drawer keeps everything inside, upgrades included, in the dropped item.

Hover over it to see the contents, then place it anywhere.
guide.storagenexus.page.7:
Barrels
Iron 45 slots (5x9), Gold 66 (6x11), Diamond 84 (6x14), Emerald 102 (6x17), Netherite 120 (6x20).

Right-click a barrel with an upgrade to upgrade it in place: Iron upgrades a vanilla barrel, Gold an Iron Barrel, and so on. Contents stay.
guide.storagenexus.page.8:
Drawer Controller
Drawers touching it, or touching each other, within 12 blocks join it.

Right-click it with an item: it goes to the drawer holding it. Double-click: your inventory.
Empty hand: outlines its reach for 1 minute (click again to hide).
guide.storagenexus.page.9:
Controller Slave
Place it touching the drawers (or the controller) within 12 blocks of the controller. Drawers within 12 blocks of the slave then join too.

Slaves chain: a slave in reach of another slave works as well.
